description.title: מכלול - הגבלת אחריות
description.summary: This table details the insurer's liability limit for legal defense expenses under the 'מכלול' policy. It specifies the maximum amount covered, which is either 50,000 NIS or the amount listed in the schedule, whichever is higher.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת 'מכלול' מגדירה את גובה האחריות המקסימלית של המבטח להוצאות הגנה משפטית בהליכים פליליים. סכום האחריות לא יעלה על 50,000 ש״ח, או הסכום המפורט בנספח הפוליסה, הגבוה מביניהם. תנאים אלו חלים בכפוף לתנאי הפוליסה והחרגות כלליות.

טבלה: מכלול - הגבלת אחריות
This table details the insurer's liability limit for legal defense expenses under the 'מכלול' policy. It specifies the maximum amount covered, which is either 50,000 NIS or the amount listed in the schedule, whichever is higher.
ממדים: Conditions for legal services, Liability limits and requirements

8.4.5.7  At the insurer's request, the insured shall provide appropriate bank guarantees to guarantee the indemnification noted in paragraph
8.4.5.6 above, which the insurer will bear. The insured will be entitled to offer the insurer other guarantees, to its satisfaction.
8.4.5.8  In the event that the insured complies with all the aforementioned conditions, it shall be entitled to legal services, subject to the policy conditions and exclusions in general, and subject to whatsoever appearing above in particular.
8.4.5.9  The insurer's limit of liability under this cover shall not exceed NIS 50,000, or the sum noted in the schedule for defense expenses in criminal proceedings (the higher of the two).
